description: A mock implementation of vscode.TextDocument for testing purposes, providing methods to manipulate and retrieve text content, line information, and document state.

classes.name: MockTextDocument
classes.description: A simulated implementation of vscode.TextDocument for testing, with methods to access and modify document content and metadata.

methods.name: constructor
methods.description: Initializes a new MockTextDocument with a URI and content string.

methods.name: updateContent
methods.description: Replaces the document content with new content and updates version and dirty state.

methods.name: getText
methods.description: Retrieves text from the document, optionally within a specified range.

methods.name: lineAt
methods.description: Returns information about a specific line in the document.

methods.name: offsetAt
methods.description: Calculates the offset in the document for a given position.

methods.name: positionAt
methods.description: Returns the position in the document for a given offset.

methods.name: save
methods.description: Simulates saving the document, resetting the dirty flag.

methods.name: getWordRangeAtPosition
methods.description: Returns the range of the word at a given position, based on a regex.

methods.name: validateRange
methods.description: Returns the input range, simplified validation.

methods.name: validatePosition
methods.description: Returns the input position, simplified validation.
